analysis.title: DeskTalk - Nvidia Earnings: Final views across Citi
key_insights: Nvidia reports earnings at 16:20 EST today with the call at 17:00 EST. The stock is down nearly 30% since its last earnings report after a broad repricing in semis and CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
Guidance on the succession plan and future leadership is expected to matter as much as the numbers.
Huang issued a statement today saying he would be honored to return as CEO if the Board decides that is in the best interest of shareholders, employees, the company and America.
Options markets price an implied move of roughly +/-8% for Nvidia tonight. Citi's equity trading strategy desk tracks Wednesday as the largest SPX event over the next month at +/- 101bps.
Citi analyst Atif Malik expects a modest EPS beat on results and guide, with higher sales offset by lower gross margins due to an HBM price increase.
Malik expects Nvidia to reiterate its prior FY28E (CY27E) revenue outlook of 70% YoY growth.
Key investor topics are 2028 order visibility and backlog conversion (especially Neocloud customers), supply constraints, the Rubin ramp, and the CEO investigation.

On November 12, before Huang's resignation, Malik lowered his price target to $225, a 20% discount to the prior 19x P/E, citing increased uncertainty. He kept a Buy rating because the stock trades at about 11x P/E, in line with its prior trough.

Citi's equity note says AI picks and shovels led positioning for more than three years, but money is now leaving memory, semi cap, analog and compute hardware. The drivers are data center spending worries, the midterms and Nvidia itself.
The open question in Citi's note is the margin outlook and strong cash return as support.
